title: StandardObjectName Share - Data API
description: StandardObjectNameShare is the model for all share objects associated with standard objects. These objects represent a sharing entry on the standard object.

AccessLevel.description: Type: picklist Properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update Description: The level of access allowed. Values are: All (owner) Edit (read/write) Read (read only)

ParentId.description: Type: reference Properties: Create, Filter, Group, Sort Description: ID of the parent record.

RowCause.description: Type: picklist Properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort Description: Reason that the sharing entry exists.

UserOrGroupId.description: Type: reference Properties: Create, Filter, Group, Sort Description: ID of the user or group that has been given access to the object.
